block_gate.quota_or_attempt_budget_stop: Pause all later blocks after the current CLI finishes.
block_gate.model_error_ratio: ERROR model records / all requested model jobs in the block; pause when >= 0.10. Heuristic is excluded.
block_gate.other_integrity_stop: Unknown/missing/invalid terminal artifacts, source/data/settings drift, cleanup failure, or any model NOT_RUN.
block_gate.ordinary_errors_below_threshold: Retain every ERROR and continue the next fixed block.
block_gate.native_deadlines_only: provider120s/operation240s; interrupted/unknown outcomes are never relaunched.

fixed_selections.audit_batches: Two disjoint 12-case identifier files; frozen before test.

analysis_policy.primary: The original full-test raw run, all 48 test cases and all outcomes; never a recovery composition.
analysis_policy.stability: Existing analyze_repeated on the explicit fixed16 subset from full-test/repeat-02/repeat-03; no intersection or best repetition.
analysis_policy.bootstrap: Keep each case and every repetition inside its source-family cluster.
analysis_policy.semantic_audit: Existing audit.prepare on the full-test raw run and the fixed24 audit cases; separate blind batches.
analysis_policy.proxies: Strict aliases and gold-span coverage are proxies; semantic audit and error coverage remain separate.

dollar_policy: Codex subscription dollars unknown; report measured calls/usage and unknown totals.
actual_source_and_dataset: Both are read from the accepted commit archive; original worktree inputs remain hash-guarded.

semantic_audit_policy.population: The fixed24 cases, all three methods from the first full original run.
semantic_audit_policy.stage1: Independent text-only alignment; partition all gold/predictions exactly once, then validate and hash-lock before stage2. Method/context/label/reasoning/citations remain hidden.
semantic_audit_policy.stage2: After the stage1 lock, review context-only S/C/U labels, sufficient evidence and quote economy, while method names remain hidden.
semantic_audit_policy.credit: Only one-to-one equivalent pairs receive semantic decomposition credit; label/evidence require their additional criteria. No automatic credit for uncertain/merged/split/scope-changed items.
semantic_audit_policy.denominators: Keep every gold/prediction and failed request in the applicable denominators. Operational errors are not U judgments.
semantic_audit_policy.no_post_test_repairs: Do not rewrite main scores, gold or aliases; record errata and uncertainty separately.
semantic_audit_policy.review_limits: The audit subset is not the full population. AI non-author review and eventual Robin human review remain distinct; no fabricated votes.

precall_policy_amendment.reason: Parent final narrow review required the existing audit policy itself to be hash-guarded before test.
